'''''Dathomir Prison''''' was a rare work of art available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It depicted the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|prison]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] shadowed by an ominous storm. [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] lettering on the bottom spelled out "Dathomir [[Prison/Legends|Prison]]." One copy of the [[Painting/Legends|painting]] hung in the office of [[Officer of Defense]] [[Victor Visalis]] at the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine's]] capitol building on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Visalis was known to occasionally give out copies of the painting to his most loyal supporters during his campaign for [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of Bestine.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Dathomir Prison'' was a painting that appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> which was released on [[June 26]], [[2003]]<ref name="Start">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20030617.html|text=''Galaxies'' to Release June 26}}</ref> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The painting was named simply "Rare painting" in the game, and players could use it in their personal house as decoration. Originally, it only appeared as a decoration in Visalis' office, but due to a bug in the early days of the game, players were able to pick up otherwise unobtainable items from various buildings and areas; ''Dathomir Prison'' was one of the items that could be picked up. The bug was later resolved, but players were allowed to keep the paintings if they already possessed them. After this, the painting was an extremely rare reward for supporting Visalis during his mayoral campaign. The painting was later added to the game's "rare loot system," which allowed exceedingly rare items to appear on the corpses of any enemy, as a comparatively easier way for players to obtain it.<ref name="SWG" />
